name: Landmine Meadows Row
cues: Stand side-on to the end of the bar in a staggered stance
Grip the thick end overhand and rest your free forearm on your front thigh
Row with your elbow travelling up and slightly out
Let the bar draw your shoulder down at the bottom

qa.note: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Redone in src/motion/templates/row/meadows.ts. The real cause of the 87 deg pronation was which side the pivot was on. With the pivot on the free side, the index finger pointed outward on an overhand grip, which isn't a natural hand position. The pivot is now on the working side, the bar runs nearly straight across (about 83 deg), the tip points to the free side, and the plates sit outside the working hand, so they never come near the front thigh. The bar now swivels: the hand's height and depth are set by the pull and the drift-back search, and the bar's yaw and pitch are solved on its sphere about the pivot. The hand drifts back about 10 cm and the bar yaw changes by a few degrees. FK: elbow 105 at the top, upper arm 0.17 behind the trunk line in the thorax frame (was +0.38), pronation 37-51 through the whole rep (was 0 to 87). The scoped forearm_r.pro [-90, 88] limit and the PRO_LIMIT constant are removed. To hold balance on the new load line, the front ankle moved from 0.20 to 0.14 m ahead of the hips (balance 25.9 of 35 mm, still judged over the front midfoot +3 cm, which is the lead's earlier call). Camera: the old az -80 looked straight down the bar with the landmine in the foreground. It is now a rear three-quarter at az -140 (+140 for left), elev 0.26, so the elbow passing the back, the sleeve and the bar out to the pivot all read, but the figure is small and sits at the left of the frame because the bar is long. The row.test 317 case now asserts pronation <=80, elbow >100, upper arm behind the trunk line (thorax-frame z <0), the hand drifting back more than 5 cm and the bar yaw changing more than 1 deg. Checks: QA passes, rebaked, bake-motion --check is fresh for every file, row.test passes 81/81, typecheck and lint are clean, and all 229 approved posters render identically.
